payload.acceptance_criteria:
When a vault commit names a record that another session holds, then the vault commit-msg hook refuses the commit, naming the holder and the claim command
When the named record has no holder, or this session's claim on it is unsettled, or the vault cannot be reached, then the hook accepts the commit and prints a visible notice line with the claim command, not a passing tick alone
When this record lands, then a note on basicly-gtb19bg.43.19 records that its criterion 4 (S5a) is superseded by criteria 1 and 2
payload.description:
## Context
When a session commits in vault mode on a record another session holds, I want the commit-msg hook to refuse it, as the local-ledger tracker-claim hook does. Today vault_commit_hook.py _judge accepts it and shows the warning under a green tick (tests/test_kit_vault_commit_hook.py test_a_record_this_session_does_not_hold_is_accepted_with_the_claim_command, holder s2). Found on the Orchestrator's commit 4dfeca8 in development. Orchestrator decision 2026-11-20 about 08:05 UTC; built by the repair session after the branch-cleanup tool. Scope: vault_commit_hook.py, the hook runner that prints the result, the test file, a changelog fragment.
payload.title: Refuse a vault commit on a record another session holds
